author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বন্ধু/আত্মীয়কে একটি informal letter/email লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a letter to your younger brother advising him to study regularly.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Sohel,
Take my love. I received your letter yesterday and was glad to know that you are well. But I was a little worried to hear that you are not studying regularly these days. So I am writing to give you some advice.

You know, our parents have great hopes about you. If you waste your time now, you will suffer in future. So, make a routine and follow it every day. Study attentively, do not neglect English and mathematics, and keep away from bad company. Take part in games too, because a sound mind lives in a sound body.

I believe you will follow my advice. Give my salam to our parents.

Your loving brother,
Rahim
rubric: 'Dear ...' দিয়ে শুরু করে স্নেহপূর্ণ ভাষায় লিখেছি
'Your loving brother' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing how you spent your last summer vacation.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Karim,
Many many thanks for your kind letter. In your letter you wanted to know how I spent my last summer vacation. I am now writing about it.

I spent my summer vacation in my village home. Every morning I walked in the green fields and enjoyed the fresh air. During the day I helped my father in the garden and read storybooks. In the afternoon I played football with my village friends. In the evening I sat with my grandmother and listened to her interesting tales. I also visited a nearby river and enjoyed boating. The days passed so happily that I did not feel bored for a single moment.

No more today. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Jamil
rubric: ছুটি কীভাবে কাটিয়েছি তা ধারাবাহিকভাবে লিখেছি
'Your loving friend' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend congratulating him on his brilliant success in the HSC examination.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Sabbir,
Congratulations! I have just heard the happy news that you have passed the HSC examination with GPA 5. I cannot tell you how delighted I am at your brilliant result.

Your success is the reward of your hard labour and sincerity. I always knew that you would shine in the examination. Your parents and teachers must be very proud of you today, and so am I. Now you should choose a good subject and get admitted into a reputed university.

Please convey my heartfelt congratulations to your parents. I am eagerly waiting to meet you and celebrate your success.

Your loving friend,
Tanvir
rubric: সাফল্যের প্রশংসা ও পরবর্তী পরামর্শ দিয়েছি
'Your loving friend' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি
